en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The rider should greet the walker, and the standing one upon the seated one’.
en.sarwar: 4. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Ash’ari from ibn al- Qaddah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
A person riding should offer greetings of peace to the one walking on foot and the one standing should offer greetings of peace to the one sitting.”
